description: The measurement of the production watch build on the physical Pebble Time 2, taken from the four RD startup lines and the RD light line of a build made with RD_BUILD_LOG=1 and installed with PEBBLE_PHONE=<ip> pnpm run device. One entry per measurement; scripts/build-report.py copies the newest of each build and face into public/reports/comparison.json.

fields.commit: git commit of the measured build
fields.build: output name of scripts/build-pebble.sh: watchface, which holds both faces, or watchface-analog. Entries without it were measured with the watchface build or its predecessor
fields.startupWallMs: wall_ms of the RD startup line: the validated slice and gap times summed until the startup and any minute refill it still owed finished (gaps of 5 s or more are excluded and flagged as interrupted)
fields.avgDrawUs: avg_draw_us (the field rendered into the framebuffer)
fields.loopMs: loop_ms of an RD_BUILD_PROFILE=1 build, 0 otherwise
fields.note: free-text context of the entry: steps, frames, burst timings, and what changed
fields.settingsLog: RD settings lines captured during this run, when available
fields.face: face shown, digital or analog (the face setting, or RD_FACE in watchface-analog). Entries without it were measured with the digital face

measurements.note: Startup 1,661 steps and 551 frames in 30.03 s. A backlight window after the startup (RD light line) ran 282 steps and 93 frames in 5.05 s: 18.4 frames per second, three steps per frame.
Settings build with default settings, RD_BUILD_LOG=1 and RD_BUILD_LOAD_LIMIT=24576, 21,688 B load. Startup 1,680 steps and 557 frames in 30.01 s.

measurements.note: Run 1 on physical Pebble Time 2 with RD_BUILD_LOG=1, 19,168 B load, using pnpm run device. Startup 1,683 steps, 565 slices, and 559 draws, with since_init_ms=30,004. RD init reported mask_ms=4. The three settings lines above were captured before startup.

Run 2 on the same physical Pebble Time 2 with the same RD_BUILD_LOG=1 PBW, 19,168 B load, using pnpm run device. Startup 1,684 steps, 565 slices, and 559 draws, with since_init_ms=30,024. The log connection missed the settings lines. No settings were changed between runs 1 and 2.

Both faces with the face setting analog, RD_BUILD_LOG=1 and RD_BUILD_LOAD_LIMIT=28672, 25,632 B load. Settings: palette 6, Da 0.8, Db 0.4, LECO, avoidance and date on. RD init mask_ms=8. Startup 1,522 steps and 582 frames in 30.02 s. A sweep 13 s after launch: 16 mask rebuilds of at most 8 ms, 1,043 ms, 44 steps. compute_max_ms 55 by the end of the startup. A sweep logged 2 s after launch moved no hand (0 rebuilds, 55 steps).

measurements.note: After the size reduction of #4, both faces with the face setting analog and the date hidden, RD_BUILD_LOG=1 and RD_BUILD_LOAD_LIMIT, 22,800 B load. Startup 1,659 steps, 600 slices, and 598 draws, with since_init_ms=30,981. A sweep 29 s after launch: 16 mask rebuilds of at most 8 ms, 1,000 ms, 46 steps. compute_max_ms 54. A sweep logged 2 s after launch moved no hand (0 rebuilds, 55 steps). The log connection missed the RD init line.

Version 5 build with both models and the settings, RD_BUILD_LOG=1, 23,816 B load, after the phone sent the fhn-spiral settings (model 1, custom palette of four stops, Bitham, date hidden): the field restarted and its startup ran 1,686 steps and 566 frames in 29.99 s. The heap minimum is that of the session, the same as with the Gray-Scott defaults.

Version 5 build with both models and the settings, RD_BUILD_LOG=1, 23,816 B load, with the default settings (Gray-Scott maze, thin stripes). Startup 1,637 steps and 549 frames in 29.95 s, one step of 106 ms. The heap minimum, 15,872 B, is 512 B below the 16 KiB target with this logging build, which loads 3,024 B more than the production build.
